easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Y'shtola Rhul's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Y'shtola Rhul's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.
